title: Non-bigness after terminal divisorial extractions over the degree-two weak-Fano blowup models of projective space and cubic threefolds
difficulty_reason: After the named terminal contraction classification and the specified weak-Fano blowup models are allowed, the author must still exclude every permitted extraction by matching the geometry of its centre to a concrete anti-canonical obstruction. The point case couples the weighted discrepancy/intersection calculation to anti-canonical volume two and a moving family of negative curves; the uncontracted curve case restricts multiplicity-n degree-n sections to a low-dimensional linear subsystem; the contracted curve case factors through a point blowup and projection, then identifies the anti-canonical image through connected fibres/Stein factorization. These distinct obstructions close the centre classification and give the rank-three rigidity application, supporting one H2. Ordinary local formulas, the finite curve-embedding/automorphism arguments, and subsequent relator/free-product manipulations are retained without additional advanced counts; no extra H3 coupling is claimed.

author_ranges.literal: However we expect the statement of Lemma 4.5 to be true for them as well: using a degeneration argument this amounts to just exhibiting one such curve with no projective automorphisms.

author_ranges.item: extension to other Fano threefold involutions
author_ranges.literal: among the lists of [Cutrone-Marshburn] there are several other examples of involutions of Fano 3-folds which have the same property. Thus it is a natural question whether the whole construction extends to these cases as well.
author_ranges.state: open question posed in the closing subsection; nothing is proved about those cases
